name: typed-split-wipe
title: Typed Split Wipe
description: A centered cursorless type build exits through opposing fixed-layout glyph wipes.
useWhen: A product or feature introduction should type itself cleanly before breaking into controlled directional fragments.
One short anchor must stay visible while the surrounding words are erased independently.
avoidWhen: You need a conventional typewriter with a blinking caret and no exit: use typewriter.
Every character should rise or move independently: use per-character-rise.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Prefix
variables.description: Words typed before the anchor. It wipes out to the left.

variables.label: Anchor
variables.description: Short word that stays visible while the rest is erased.

variables.label: Suffix
variables.description: Words typed after the anchor. They wipe out one by one.

variables.label: Word stagger
variables.description: Frames between each suffix word wiping out.

variables.label: Anchor shift
variables.description: Pixels the anchor slides left at 42 px type, as the prefix wipes away.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Type size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
